tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibit panels presenting the DAO charter and measurable outcomes.
tasks.terrain: Flat flagstone floor of an Oxford hall, low exhibit plinths, crowded visitor circulation near doorways
success: Visits all 5 exhibit waypoints in order
Deviation from path under 0.3 m RMS
Completes tour within 8 minutes
Speech narration triggers at each waypoint
safety_stops: Stop if human within 0.5 m
E-stop on tilt over 15 degrees
Pause speech if visitor query detected
Halt on battery below 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script and charter wording before public deployment.

tasks.goal: Retrieve and shelve bound research volumes between desk stations and the stacks in the Research Synthesis Lab.
tasks.terrain: Lab desks and narrow stack aisles; volumes of varying mass on shelves at 0.4-1.8 m height
success: Picks 10 of 10 volumes without slip (wrench anomaly < 5 N)
Places within 2 cm of target slot
Zero shelf collisions
Cycle time under 25 s per volume
safety_stops: Stop if external wrench exceeds 40 N
Stop if human inside 1 m workspace envelope
Joint velocity limit 0.5 rad/s near shelving
E-stop on controller fault
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab steward approves which archive volumes may be handled by the arm.

tasks.goal: Transport proposal document crates from the staging area to forum debate stations and collect ballots for human tallying.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and cobbled Oxford paths between forum stations, kerb cuts, wet grass verges along the meadow edge
success: Delivers 4 crates to correct stations
Localization drift under 0.5 m over route
Zero pedestrian near-misses (< 1 m closure)
Ballot crate returned intact
safety_stops: Stop if pedestrian within 2 m
Speed limit 1.0 m/s on cobble
Stop on wheel slip over 20%
Halt on IP67-irrelevant water ingress sensor alert
tasks.human_in_loop: People open crates, read proposals, and cast the deciding votes; the robot only moves documents.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow inspection circuit over the Progress Observatory display wall, capturing imagery of outcome dashboards for archiving.
tasks.terrain: High vaulted ceiling with timber beams; open meadow windows create gusts; hanging display banners
success: Completes 3 full circuits at 2.5 m altitude
Maintains position within 0.2 m of flight path
Captures legible images of all 6 dashboard panels
Battery above 3.0 V at landing
safety_stops: Land immediately if battery below 3.7 V
Land if wind gust exceeds 6 m/s
Avoid beams with 1 m clearance envelope
Land if human enters flight volume
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews captured dashboard imagery and approves its archival.

tasks.goal: Run supply rounds delivering printouts, cables and hardware kits from the Operations Deck stores to working-group desks.
tasks.terrain: Raised floor cables and desk-chair clutter across the deck; door thresholds between rooms
success: Completes 6 delivery stops per round
Object placement within 5 cm of desktop targets
Zero collisions with chairs or thresholds
Round time under 12 minutes
safety_stops: Stop if human within 0.8 m
Stop if torso load exceeds 8 kg
Halt on wheel current spike (threshold/entrapment)
Pause at closed doors for human opening
tasks.human_in_loop: Working-group leads confirm each delivery manifest before the round starts.

tasks.goal: Patrol Charter Hall after hours checking doors, exhibits and environmental sensors, logging anomalies for stewards.
tasks.terrain: Stone hall floors with uneven flagstones, exhibit plinths, low lighting after hours
success: Covers all 5 zones of the hall in 20-minute patrol
Detects and logs anomalies with under 5% false-positive rate
Stair-free route maintained throughout
Autonomous dock on completion
safety_stops: Sit down if human detected after hours
Stop on terrain beyond mobility envelope
Halt if battery below 20% before dock leg
Stop if anomaly confidence below threshold flagged for review
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews logged anomalies and decides any follow-up action.

tasks.goal: Tend bench experiments by swapping sample trays between storage rack and lab bench positions on a fixed schedule.
tasks.terrain: Benchtop with glassware and tray racks; tight 30 cm clearance lanes between instruments
success: Swaps 12 trays per session with zero glassware contact
Insertion force under 10 N
Tray alignment within 3 mm
Schedule adherence within 60 s
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact force over 15 N
Stop if human within 0.7 m of bench
Joint speed limit 0.2 m/s Cartesian near glassware
Pause if tray ID mismatch detected
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher approves the tray schedule and may pause the arm at any time.

tasks.goal: Survey the Operations Deck's outdoor perimeter along the Christ Church Meadow fence line, logging gate status and path conditions.
tasks.terrain: River-valley grass and mud along the Cherwell-side fence, cattle-fence stiles, seasonal flooding on low paths
success: Surveys 400 m perimeter with 3 gate checks
Localization drift under 1 m over loop
Gate status images legible for all 3 gates
Returns to deck within 30 minutes
safety_stops: Stop if water depth detected over 5 cm
Stop if human or dog within 2 m
Low-power sit at battery below 20%
Halt on slope exceeding 25 degrees
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews gate-status findings and authorizes any maintenance tasking.
